title: rosa agrestis var. denudata
intro: Rosa agrestis var. denudata, commonly known as wild rose or Rosa rugosa, is a deciduous shrub native to East Asia, prized for its fragrant flowers, edible hips, and medicinal properties. The plant has been used in traditional medicine to promote digestive health, reduce inflammation, and alleviate menstrual discomfort, thanks to its therapeutic actions as a laxative, anti-inflammatory, and emmenagogue. The bioactive constituents of Rosa agrestis var. denudata include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, which are responsible for its health benefits and medicinal properties. Regular consumption of Rosa agrestis var. denudata is believed to boost the immune system, improve cardiovascular health, and provide antioxidant protection against oxidative stress.
